name: sadin
description: SADIN: protective middleware between employees and AI tools. The extension and the inspection service have no npm dependencies; the packages below are used by the tests only.

scripts.test: node eval/run.js --quiet && node eval/run.js --holdout --quiet && node eval/run.js --set=arabic-dev --quiet && node eval/run.js --set=arabic-holdout --quiet && node eval/check-results.js && node eval/version-check.js && node eval/robustness.js && node server/integrity.js --check && node eval/tamper/server-test.js && node eval/server-hardening-test.js
scripts.version: node scripts/release.js && node server/integrity.js && git add extension/manifest.json README.md server/integrity.json
